Dr. Emily Rodriguez  
Senior Data Science Lecturer  
TechNova Academy  
emily.rodriguez@technova.ac  
[Date]  

To Whom It May Concern,  

I am writing to wholeheartedly recommend Alex Carter for any opportunity requiring a lead data engineering mind. As a peer at TechNova Academy, I collaborated closely with Alex on several high-stakes e-commerce data initiatives, where his technical rigor and leadership left a lasting impression.  

Alex’s mastery of Snowflake and dbt stands out. Over three years, he rearchitected our data warehouse, transitioning from legacy systems to Snowflake, which reduced query latency by 40% and enabled real-time analytics. His dbt pipelines, which he mentored our junior team to adopt, now handle 90% of our transformation workflows, ensuring data consistency across 12+ business units.  

His AWS expertise is equally impactful. Alex designed a serverless ETL pipeline using Airflow, cutting infrastructure costs by 30% while scaling to handle 50M+ daily transactions. This system, which he owns end-to-end, has become a benchmark for our team’s cloud strategy.  

Beyond technical skills, Alex’s work ethic is unmatched. He consistently prioritizes data quality, once identifying a 15% data discrepancy in our Kafka streams that could have cost the company millions. His ability to balance innovation with operational stability makes him a rare asset.  

I cannot recommend Alex highly enough. His combination of technical depth, leadership, and integrity will serve any organization exceptionally well.  

Sincerely,  
Dr. Emily Rodriguez
